anomalies.description: A person is forcefully attempting to open or breach a front door at night, using both hands to push/pull with apparent effort; the posture and repeated motion suggest forced entry rather than normal access (e.g., no visible key use, no greeting, no lighting of porch). The setting (dark, snowy, isolated) and behavior align with burglary via forced entry.

original_descriptions.description: A person is forcefully attempting to open or breach a front door at night, using both hands to push/pull with apparent effort; the posture and repeated motion suggest forced entry rather than normal access (e.g., no visible key use, no greeting, no lighting of porch). The setting (dark, snowy, isolated) and behavior align with burglary via forced entry.

A person is forcefully attempting to open or breach a front door at night, using both hands to push/pull the door with apparent effort and persistence over multiple seconds. The individual is positioned close to the door, leaning in, suggesting forced entry rather than normal access (e.g., no visible key use, no greeting, no prior approach indicating expected visit). This behavior aligns with burglary via forced entry.

A person is seen forcefully manipulating a red door at night, appearing to pry or break it open; after several seconds of effort, the person steps back and retreats from the doorway, consistent with attempted forced entry (burglary).
